metadata.purpose: Traceable credibility register for operational HYROX training-plan knowledge
metadata.selection_policy: Use primary research, systematic reviews, and consensus statements for constraints. Use a verified video transcript only for clearly-labelled coach practice. Do not use title, subscriber count, social engagement, or a speaker’s elite result as evidence of causation.

hyrox_direct.title: Acute physiological responses and performance determinants in Hyrox
hyrox_direct.authors: Brandt T, Ebel C, Lebahn C, Schmidt A
hyrox_direct.population_or_context: 11 recreational athletes; simulated Individual Open HYROX
hyrox_direct.credibility_tier: A for direct relevance; limited for generalization
hyrox_direct.operational_use: Describe HYROX physiological demands and support an endurance emphasis with stated limitations.
hyrox_direct.do_not_infer: A causal universal program, fixed session split, fixed heart-rate zone, or a population-wide performance predictor.

transfer_evidence.title: International society of sports nutrition position stand: nutrient timing
transfer_evidence.operational_use: Contextual education about fueling, recovery, carbohydrate, and protein timing.
transfer_evidence.do_not_infer: A required HYROX grams-per-hour, sodium, pre-race, or post-race protocol.

transfer_evidence.title: Sleep and the athlete: narrative review and 2021 expert consensus recommendations
transfer_evidence.operational_use: Sleep screening, long-term behavior, travel-risk management, and trend-based readiness language.
transfer_evidence.do_not_infer: A universal sleep target, wearable diagnosis, clinical sleep management, or automatic session cancellation.

transfer_evidence.title: IOC consensus statement: dietary supplements and the high-performance athlete
transfer_evidence.operational_use: Supplement safety, trial-in-training, qualified-review, and anti-doping guardrails.
transfer_evidence.do_not_infer: An obligatory HYROX supplement protocol, dosing advice, medical safety clearance, or guaranteed benefit.

transfer_evidence.title: Load Management: What It Is and What It Is Not!
transfer_evidence.operational_use: Progressive overload, specificity, variation, individualization, and recovery as planning principles.
transfer_evidence.do_not_infer: A fixed injury-prediction threshold, especially from one workload metric.

transfer_evidence.title: Strength training as superior, dose-dependent and safe prevention of acute and overuse sports injuries
transfer_evidence.source_type: Systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs
transfer_evidence.operational_use: Retain appropriately progressed strength work for general tissue-capacity and injury-risk-reduction rationale.
transfer_evidence.do_not_infer: That an individual exercise prevents a particular injury or that the trial protocols are HYROX-specific.

transfer_evidence.title: Deloading Practices in Strength and Physique Sports
transfer_evidence.credibility_tier: C+ for causal claims; useful for practice mapping
transfer_evidence.operational_use: Offer individualized lower-stress weeks as an adjustable planning option.
transfer_evidence.do_not_infer: A mandatory deload frequency, duration, or volume reduction for HYROX athletes.

verified_expert_video_sources.speaker: Dr Dan Plews
verified_expert_video_sources.credentials_verified: Exercise physiologist and endurance coach; credentials recorded in transcript audit.
verified_expert_video_sources.credibility_tier: A- as coach practice; not primary HYROX intervention evidence
verified_expert_video_sources.operational_use: Optional frequency/volume-first hierarchy and individualized taper discussion.
verified_expert_video_sources.do_not_infer: Elite training hours, a 50% taper, or 10-15% performance improvement for every athlete.

verified_expert_video_sources.speaker: Dr Dan Plews
verified_expert_video_sources.credentials_verified: Exercise physiologist and endurance coach; credentials recorded in transcript audit.
verified_expert_video_sources.operational_use: Optional low-intensity station/erg session concepts and individualized technique experiments.
verified_expert_video_sources.do_not_infer: Fixed LT1 or heart-rate targets, mandatory session lengths, or universal burpee technique.

verified_expert_video_sources.speaker: Rich Ryan, Ryan Kent, and Meg Jacoby
verified_expert_video_sources.credentials_verified: Elite HYROX competitors and coaches; credentials recorded in transcript audit.
verified_expert_video_sources.operational_use: Progress one or two new station exposures at a time and normalize recovery review.
verified_expert_video_sources.do_not_infer: A race-time prerequisite for Pro or clinical injury management advice.

verified_expert_video_sources.speaker: Gommaar D'Hulst / WOD Science
verified_expert_video_sources.credentials_verified: Sport-science researcher and educator; credentials recorded in transcript audit.
verified_expert_video_sources.operational_use: Require deficit analysis before selecting strength dose.
verified_expert_video_sources.do_not_infer: One weekly strength session is sufficient for all HYROX athletes.

verified_expert_video_sources.speaker: WOD Science
verified_expert_video_sources.credentials_verified: Sport-science educator; credentials recorded in transcript audit.
verified_expert_video_sources.operational_use: Teach fuel practice and individual GI-tolerance tracking alongside position-statement evidence.
verified_expert_video_sources.do_not_infer: A compulsory 4 g/kg preload or 60-90 g/h race protocol.

verified_expert_video_sources.speaker: Triage Nutrition
verified_expert_video_sources.credentials_verified: Performance-nutrition practitioner; detail in transcript audit.
verified_expert_video_sources.operational_use: Prompt a dietitian-aware review of nutrition periodization.
verified_expert_video_sources.do_not_infer: Calorie floors, energy-availability diagnosis, or individualized diet prescription.

context_only_or_excluded.reason: Speaker credentials are strong but no transcript was available. Use Walsh et al. 2021 as the operational source instead.

context_only_or_excluded.source: Predicting HYROX Performance in Elite Athletes: Station Contributions and Training Implications
context_only_or_excluded.reason: Previously recorded as a ResearchGate preprint without direct verification in this audit. Excluded from operational rules until primary source, methods, and peer-review status are verified.

context_only_or_excluded.source: HYROX Sports Science Report 2025 via social media
context_only_or_excluded.reason: Social-media repost is not an adequate primary source. Excluded from operational rules until the official report is publicly available and directly verified.
